mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 8.0% indicate persistent labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 8.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 450.0 thousand units signal a contraction in residential investment, which precedes reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 450.0 in any month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 95.0 (index) indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate capacity utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as profit margins contract.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 95.0 in any month but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE above 9.0%) signals an active monetary policy response to recession, triggering a market rebound within 20 trading days as policy support materializes.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND UNRATE > 9.0 in any month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: Recessionary quarters (GDPC1 below 11300.0 billion) initially depress equity valuations but trigger policy responses that generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate economic stabilization.
failure_condition: GDPC1 < 11300.0 in any quarter but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such recession quarters.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE above 8.5%) initially cause market volatility but prompt policy interventions that result in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic recovery expectations strengthen.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.5 in any month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (below 450.0) and retail sales (below 330000.0) indicate a broad-based consumer spending collapse, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings revisions accelerate.
failure_condition: HOUST < 450.0 AND RSAFS < 330000.0 in any month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such triggered months.
